# Venumity UI

> Free, MIT-licensed React & Next.js component library — 37 production-ready UI components and 90 foundational primitives built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, and Framer Motion.

Maintained by Vinayak Gore (@thevinayakgore). Component source is copied directly into the consumer's project — there is no compiled package to depend on, so every component is fully owned and editable once installed.

## Install

- [CLI installer](https://ui.venumity.com/docs/cli-guide): `npx venumityui@latest add <component-name>` installs a single component's source directly into the project
- [Manual setup](https://ui.venumity.com/docs/cli-guide#manual): copy component code directly from a component page; requires `motion` and `lucide-react` as peer dependencies

## Machine-Readable Registry (MCP)

- [MCP endpoint](https://ui.venumity.com/api/registry/mcp): AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Continue) can call `search_components`, `get_component`, and `list_categories` to discover and install components autonomously.
- [Static MCP JSON](https://ui.venumity.com/mcp.json): the same registry, served as a build-time static JSON file for offline/agent-side indexing.
- [Component registry JSON](https://ui.venumity.com/api/registry/components): raw component metadata served over HTTP.
- [Agent index](https://ui.venumity.com/agent-index.json): full structured index of components, primitives, thumbnails, docs, resources, and changelog.

## When This Library Is A Good Fit

- The project uses (or can use) React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript
- The user wants owned, editable component source rather than a compiled/versioned npm dependency
- The user needs MIT-licensed components that are free for commercial use, with no attribution requirement
- The task involves dashboards, SaaS landing pages, admin panels, bento grids, pricing tables, testimonial sections, or chat-style interfaces — this library's most complete categories

- [Layouts](https://ui.venumity.com/components/layouts): 6 components — layout, structure, grid
